schema_note: Recommendation rules for DD Engine Stage 7. Templates are string interpolation only — never model-generated. No template → no flag. DEAD list is closed; nothing outside it may produce DEAD. PROVISIONAL_CONFLICT is flag-only, never a verdict driver.

dead_rules.what: Parcel is Agricultural No-Development Zone with no individual conversion route on file
dead_rules.why: Usable development rights are legally barred under NDZ without a conversion path
dead_rules.cost: Deal cannot proceed on zoning grounds until a confirmed conversion route exists at confidence ≥90

dead_rules.what: Third-party RERA registration exists on the same survey number
dead_rules.why: Another promoter already holds statutory registration over this land
dead_rules.cost: Title cannot be cleared for GA acquisition while that registration stands

dead_rules.why: Court proceedings put ownership and transfer at risk
dead_rules.cost: Acquisition is blocked until the suit is disposed or settled with advocate confirmation

dead_rules.what: Devasthan / Inam / Watan tenure where transfer is legally barred
dead_rules.why: Statutory bar prevents lawful conveyance to GA
dead_rules.cost: Deal is dead on tenure unless a court/collector route is proven at confidence ≥90

dead_rules.why: Government acquisition overrides private deal economics
dead_rules.cost: Cannot acquire free title while notification remains in force

dead_rules.why: CRZ-I prohibits the development GA screens for
dead_rules.cost: No viable buildable envelope under coastal regulation

repriced_rules.what: Rulebook exclusion or low usable FSI applies ({rulebook_key})
repriced_rules.why: Permissible buildable area is below the UDCPR baseline the ask implies
repriced_rules.cost: Negotiate to revised max land Rate per Sq. Ft. {max_land_rate_text} ({gap_text})

repriced_rules.what: Reservation or road widening reduces net developable area
repriced_rules.why: Gross area overstates what GA can build on
Conversion cost and delay change residual land value
repriced_rules.cost: Reprice using {max_land_rate_text} until conversion is confirmed

delayed_rules.why: Additional clearances sit on the critical path
delayed_rules.cost: Add {delay_weeks_low}–{delay_weeks_high} weeks before a development start can be assumed

delayed_rules.why: Separate bye-laws and clearances extend timeline
Coastal clearance and FAR cuts delay and reshape the product
delayed_rules.cost: Add {delay_weeks_low}–{delay_weeks_high} weeks; reprice if FAR cut is confirmed

delayed_rules.what: Authority conflict involving MIDC / NAINA / CIDCO ({authorities_text})
delayed_rules.why: Wrong rulebook assumption invalidates FSI and timeline until architect confirms

flag_only_rules.why: Taluka default must not be asserted; architect register row required
flag_only_rules.cost: Flag only — does not drive DEAD, REPRICED, or DELAYED on its own
